paras: The rear of the M2 looks far more aggressive when you add this carbon fibre rear spoiler. The ADRO carbon fibre spoiler was designed specifically for the M2 platform, meaning it fits like a factory part and accents the factory design elements of the M2. Pair that with the durability and style of it's real carbon fibre construction, and you'll see just how big of a difference this spoiler makes on the M2.
